company.name: ZeeWhere
company.description: Meet people , Chat and interact . Get to know who is around you . Share Photos & Videos with the people around you. Experience the social networking with Augmented Reality. Chat and follow up with your friends and surroundings . ZeeWhere is a social network that connects people on different levels , by Location , Friends , popularity . The concept is to keep people around you connected .Most Social Networks focus on people you have as friends, ZeeWhere focuses on what's near you . Moreover , The user will never run out of things to view, because there always posts of people who are not from their Friend Zone.
